import re
from datetime import datetime

parsed_data = []
for note in all_note_details:
    title = note['title']
    # Extract date from title like "Habit Tracking Log for 2023-05-17"
    match = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', title)
    if not match:
        continue
    date_str = match.group(1)
    content = note['content']
    lines = content.strip().split('\n')
    # Skip the first line (header)
    habit_lines = [line for line in lines[1:] if ':' in line]
    habits = {}
    for line in habit_lines:
        parts = line.split(':', 1)
        habit_name = parts[0].strip()
        value = parts[1].strip().lower()
        habits[habit_name] = value
    parsed_data.append({'date': date_str, 'habits': habits})

# Sort by date
parsed_data.sort(key=lambda x: x['date'])
print(f"Parsed {len(parsed_data)} notes")
print(parsed_data[0])

# Fetch all habit tracking notes (paginate)
all_notes = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    result = apis.simple_note.search_notes(
        access_token=simple_note_token,
        query='habit',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    # Filter only notes with title matching "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    habit_notes = [n for n in result if re.match(r'Habit Tracking Log for \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', n['title'])]
    all_notes.extend(habit_notes)
    if len(result) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

parsed_data = []
for note in all_notes:
    note_content = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=simple_note_token, note_id=note['note_id'])
    # Extract date from title
    date_match = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note['title'])
    date = date_match.group(1)
    # Parse content lines: "habit: yes/no"
    habits = {}
    for line in note_content['content'].split('\n'):
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line:
            habit, value = line.split(':', 1)
            habits[habit.strip()] = value.strip().lower()
    parsed_data.append({'date': date, 'habits': habits})

parsed_data.sort(key=lambda x: x['date'])

# Determine habit order from the first (earliest) note
habit_order = list(parsed_data[0]['habits'].keys())

    row = entry['date'] + ',' + ','.join(entry['habits'].get(h, 'no') for h in habit_order)

    access_token=file_system_token,
    file_path='/home/troy/downloads/habit_tracker.csv',
    content=csv_content,
    overwrite=True
)
print(create_result)
